CustomField.description: When checked, TeamsMessageService builds the message exactly as configured (template and recipients checked) but sends it only to the dry-run addresses (EmailServiceSettings__c.DryRunAddresses__c), with a banner listing the real recipients at the top of the message.
CustomField.inlineHelpText: Check to test this Teams message: it is sent only to the Dry Run Addresses of the Email and Notification Service Settings (Custom Setting), with the real recipients listed at the top. Uncheck to go live.
CustomField.label: Dry Run
